title: THE IDEA OF NATIONAL REVIVAL IN THE LEGACY OF ABDURAUF FITRAT AND ITS ROLE IN THE DEVELOPMENT OF MODERN SOCIETY
description: This article analyzes the essence and content of the idea of national revival in the legacy of Abdurauf Fitrat, a prominent representative of the Jadid movement, and its socio-philosophical foundations and significance in the development of modern society. Fitrat’s ideas on national identity, enlightenment, social justice, human dignity, and spiritual perfection are examined in the context of contemporary reforms and the development strategy of New Uzbekistan.
